description: This file provides a WebSocket wrapper implementation for real-time features such as notifications, data streaming, and signals within a web frontend. It includes functions to create WebSocket connections, handling different endpoints including notifications, utilizing environment variables for configuration.

methods.name: createWebSocket(endpoint, onMessage, onError)
methods.description: Creates a WebSocket client connection to a specified endpoint, setting up callbacks for message and error events.

methods.name: connectNotificationWebSocket({ onMessage, onError })
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection specifically for notifications, using environment variables for configuration, defaulting to localhost if none provided.
